scope: Technical onboarding only. Pending gates are never passed by this manifest.

ci.images: scripts/ci/image.mjs <catalog target id>; all 23 artifacts retain native, UID, health, no-shell, scan and SBOM gates
ci.integrationExecution: Hosted integration runs on its isolated CI runner. For local workstation acceptance, use with-heavy around scripts/acceptance.mjs --run and run two-stack separately after that lease releases. Do not wrap the full CI integration command in with-heavy: its two-stack subgate acquires its own exclusive lease.
ci.canonicalPixels: Existing C002-C014 and F010 pinned Linux workflows
ci.windowsDeviceEvidence: Required separately; not executed in this Linux environment

twoStackIsolation.wrapper: Acquires its own heavy lease; do not wrap in with-heavy.
twoStackIsolation.scope: Two simultaneous real PostgreSQL containers, volumes, ports, cluster IDs, credentials and sentinel data; not broker/browser isolation.

ownershipTrust.checkerFrom: independently reviewed immutable policy commit / protected workflow
ownershipTrust.registryFrom: exact protected base, or externally reviewed SHA256 for the first promotion
ownershipTrust.writerPlanFrom: separately reviewed policy commit + protected SHA256, binding exact base/head/path writers
ownershipTrust.doNotUse: A PR-selected checker, candidate-generated approval digest, or shared GitHub author approval

heavyGate.mode: one with-heavy wrapper per workstation; all worktrees use one absolute state-root

blockedUntilVerified: Fresh exact-source migration/upgrade/broker and two-stack acceptance after latest-target refresh
Fresh 23 non-root independent container/security/SBOM checks after latest-target refresh
Fresh source/security/CodeQL and affected canonical browser checks
Independent review and enforced protected ownership policy with an eligible independent code owner
A packet receipt and affected-owner review of merged B/C/D proposal documents; bootstrap prerequisite and exact contract compatibility acceptance
Final resulting main SHA checks and BASE_W02 release

f001.limitation: Complete local F001 code-candidate scope only. Later documentation/source changes require affected reruns; final-source CI and independent review remain pending.

BChecks.limitation: Snapshot only; refresh after owner investigation/reruns, no peer edits or log disclosure.

latestTargetObservation.limitation: Merged proposal documents are not approved contract or policy release. Candidate source changed; prior checks require exact-source reruns.

previousSourceHostedEvidence.limitation: Prior source only; latest-target merge and evidence edits require fresh checks. No independent review, business completion, Windows/device or resulting-main acceptance.
